alignment.description: Alignment position of the conky window (e.g., top_left, top_right, bottom_left, etc.)

background.description: Whether to run conky in the background (detached from the terminal)

border_width.description: Width of the border around the conky window

cpu_avg_samples.description: Number of CPU samples used for averaging

double_buffer.description: Whether to use double buffering to reduce flicker

draw_borders.description: Whether to draw borders around text

draw_graph_borders.description: Whether to draw borders around graphs

extra_newline.description: Whether to print an extra newline at the end of output

gap_x.description: Horizontal gap (in pixels) between conky window and screen edge

gap_y.description: Vertical gap (in pixels) between conky window and screen edge

minimum_height.description: Minimum height (in pixels) of the conky window

minimum_width.description: Minimum width (in pixels) of the conky window

net_avg_samples.description: Number of network samples used for averaging

no_buffers.description: Whether to avoid using buffers when reading /proc or /sys

out_to_ncurses.description: Whether to output to ncurses (text mode)

out_to_wayland.description: Whether to output to Wayland compositor (if supported)

own_window.description: Whether to create a separate window for conky

own_window_class.description: Window class name for the conky window

own_window_type.description: Window type (e.g., normal, desktop, dock, panel)

own_window_hints.description: Window hints for window manager behavior

use_spacer.description: Where to place spacers (none, left, right)
